evidence_class: software integration and numerical endurance only; not a physical test or flight result

fingerprinting.aggregate_rule: Hash UTF-8 relative-path, tab, per-file hex digest, newline records sorted by relative path.

method.body_support: Artificial kinematic stand. At each accepted tick only rigid-body position, attitude, velocity, and angular rates are restored to the initial free-air pose and zero body velocity/rates. The coupled engine, fuel, thermal, RPM, firing, and work state is not reset.
method.commands: Warm already-running setup; full throttle (1.0); nominal mixture from each selected profile.
method.sampling: time zero and once per simulated second; every accepted tick checks fuel mass is finite and nonnegative.
method.source_input_binding: Each run records per-file source and input SHA-256 maps before and after execution. Any mismatch or missing file invalidates that run.
method.stop_policy: Stop at engine extinguishment/fuel exhaustion, simulation or telemetry fault, or the 900 s simulated-time cap. The bench does not clamp fuel; every accepted committed fuel state is checked for finiteness and nonnegativity.
method.support_impulse_work_caveat: Rigid-body kinematic restoration is external support. Its impulse and work are not modeled or reported; engine/shaft/propeller/thrust/chemical work values remain model accumulators under this constrained body state.

physical_validation: not performed; no measured engine-stand data are represented
